content.title: Offset Kids: How many children the rapper has - including those with Cardi B
content.text: Rapper Offset is back in the spotlight, this time due to a violent incident that took place on April 6, 2026. The Migos member was shot outside a casino in Florida, raising concern not only about his health but also about the impact this type of situation has on his family-especially his children.What happened to Offset today?According to police reports and media outlets, the artist was shot in the valet area of a casino in Hollywood, Florida, around 7 p.m.He was taken to a hospital with non-life-threatening injuries. He is currently stable and recovering.Two people were detained, and the investigation is ongoing.The incident brings back painful memories within the rapper's circle, especially following the death of Takeoff in 2022, who was also killed in a shooting.How many kids does Offset have?Offset is the father of six children from different relationships:Three children with Cardi B:Kulture Kiari Cephus (born on July 10, 2018)Wave Set Cephus (born on Sep. 4, 2021)Blossom Belle Cephus (born on Sept. 7, 2024)Three children from previous relationships:Jordan Cephus (born on Dec. 21, 2009), with an unidentified womanKody Cephus (born March 2, 2015), with ex Oriel Jamie.Kalea Marie Cephus (born on March 23, 2015), with rapper Shya L'amour.His role as a father has been a central part of his public image, even highlighted in his album Father of 4, where he reflects on his relationships with his children.Family context: separation and media tensionOffset's family life has also been under heavy media scrutiny in recent years. His relationship with Cardi B has gone through multiple ups and downs, including a divorce filing in 2024 after nearly seven years of marriage.Despite their separation, both continue to co-parent their children, making incidents involving the rapper's safety even more significant.
